$NVDAB is sitting at 154.03 USDT, down 6.936% on the day. The token hit a high of 169.03 and a low of 150.69, with about 67.2 million USDT changing hands.

$SNDKB took the biggest hit, sliding 11.956% to 78.28 USDT. Its 24-hour swing was the widest at roughly 19.2%, ranging from 75.07 up to 90.1, and it moved about 11.5 million USDT in volume.

Cerebras' bStock, $CBRSB, is at 89.45 USDT after a 10.326% drop. The token's range was 16.11%, bouncing between 86.22 and 100.63, with 751 k USDT traded.

$NVDAB jumped to $157.94 and swung about three times its usual daily range, up 15.6% in 24 h.

$ZEC slipped to $742, its price wobbling roughly double the normal spread and down 6.8% today.

$SOL sat at $70.77, moving nearly twice as far as it normally does and slipping 2.4% over the day.

All three tokens traded with a 24-hour range well over twice their weekly average.

$BTC slipped a hair, up 0.149% to $61,275.46. It bounced between $60,386 low and $64,603.12 high, a 6.88% swing, and hauled the most USDT volume at about $1.71 billion.

$ETH fell 0.699% to $1,710.83, the biggest absolute move of the three. Its 24-hour range hit 8.68% (high $1,845.07, low $1,696.5), the widest slice, while trading roughly $780 million in USDT.

$BNB nudged down 0.461% to $556.76, trading in a 6.56% band from $550.82 to $587.36 and moving about $96 million in USDT.

$SNDKB barely moved, its 24-hour swing was about 95% tighter than usual, landing at $84.38 with a 5.12% gain.

$ZEC's daily band was roughly 63% tighter than its week-average, trading around $786.66 and slipping just 0.1%.

$SOXLB showed a somewhat tighter range, about 47% less volatile than normal, and jumped 10% to $35.6.

All three tokens kept their price swings well below their typical daily ranges.

$NEAR jumped 4.2% to $2.99, hitting a high of $3.06, while $XRP slipped just under 1% to $0.9284, low of $0.9118. Meanwhile $SOL eased 0.6% to $70.3, trading between $68.74 and $71.43. Volume was strongest on $NEAR with about 66.9 M USDT, $XRP moved roughly 72.5 M USDT and $SOL topped 130 M USDT.

$SOXLB is sitting at $32.47, down 0.49% in the last 24 h. Its price swing was about 67% tighter than its usual weekly range, moving only ~7% today versus a 21% average.

$HYPE traded around $60.13, up 2.56%. The token's range was roughly 22% tighter than normal, a 7.5% swing compared with a 9.7% average.

Both pairs stayed well inside their typical volatility bands. The data shows $SOXLB's range at 6.99% and $HYPE's at 7.52% for the day.

$SNDKB nudged up to 80.73 USDT, a 1.03% rise, after hitting a high of 81.9 USDT and testing a low near 77.63 USDT. The tokenized stock saw the biggest absolute price move among the three.

$CRCLB slipped a touch, down 0.61% to 49.11 USDT, with a 9.47% 24-hour range, the widest swing here. Volume was hefty, 30,705,039 USDT moving through the Binance bStock market.

Micron's $MUB held steady, up 1.02% at 610.59 USDT, trading between 584.96 USDT and 614.52 USDT. It logged 25,924,705 USDT in 24-hour volume.

$ETH slipped 0.5% against $BTC, so it's losing a bit of relative strength. Meanwhile $BTC dropped 5.94% in the last 24 h, but that's still better than the median alt, which fell 7.95% across the 19-coin basket. In short, BTC's outpacing the typical alt, while ETH's giving ground to BTC.

$TRX slipped 2.9% to $0.3016 on 29.7 M USDT volume, while $SOXLB plunged 31.1% to $31.75 on a hefty 126.7 M USDT volume, a one-day move this big is an outlier. $ZEC also fell hard, down 15.5% to $754.43 with 240.2 M USDT traded, another outlier swing. All three saw massive volume behind the drops.

$BTC slipped 0.64% while most alts were also down, 63% fell versus 37% that rose. The median alt only dropped 0.29%, so it held up a bit better than BTC. With 19 alts in the sample, the typical 24-hour swing was 6.87%. That's the whole picture for the last day.

$SOL slipped a bit to $74.71, but its 24-hour swing was only about 4.16%, roughly 41% tighter than its usual week-long range.

$BNB sat at $588.54, down 0.62%, and moved within a 3.12% band, that's about 37% narrower than normal.

$ZEC held near $936.75, fell 1.75%, and its price only roamed 6.73% today, making the range roughly 31% tighter than the average.
$SOXLB jumped to $51.76 and swung about 51% wider than its usual daily range. The 24-hour price spread hit 24.0%, well above the 15.9% average. That's a noticeably wider move for today.

$BNB barely budged, trading around $589.46 and ending the day about 50% tighter than its usual 7-day swing.

$XRP nudged up to $0.9687, its 24-hour range roughly 45% narrower than normal, a modestly tighter day.

$ZEC held steady near $924.84, also seeing its daily swing about 45% tighter than the week-average.

All three tokens moved within a much tighter band than they typically do.

$ETH is gaining on $BTC, up 1.07% in the BTC pair. Meanwhile $BTC slipped 0.36% over 24 h, while the median alt in the 19-coin basket rose about 0.30%. So the typical alt outperformed Bitcoin, but ETH is still pulling ahead of BTC directly.

$ASTER jumped 8.632% to $0.5701, trading near its high of $0.5768, while $HYPE nudged up 4.424% to $70.81 and stayed just under its peak. On the flip side, $SOXLB slid 13.999% down to $48.84, hitting a low of $48.20. $SOXLB's 24-hour drop was the steepest among the trio.

$BNB barely budged, trading around $590.6. Its 24-hour swing was about 49% tighter than usual, so the market was pretty calm for BNB.

$ZEC slipped a touch to $890.19, down 0.2% in the last day. The daily range came in roughly 48% narrower than its typical week-long volatility.

$NEAR held steady near $3.151, up a half percent. Its price window was also about 48% tighter than the norm.

$BTC slipped 1.36% in the last 24 h. The alt crowd also fell, with the median down 0.76% and 63% of them in the red. Most alts (19 of them) moved lower, but it wasn't a clean sweep, 37% managed to stay up. The typical alt's 24-hour range was about 9.2%. $BTC held up about the same as the median alt, so neither side really out-performed. All in all, a mixed-direction day with a clear tilt toward downside across the board.

$DOGE swung hard, its 24-hour range about 2.6 times its usual spread and the token dropped 8.03% to $0.05795.

$HYPE was next, covering roughly 2.4 times its typical daily swing and slid 6.12% to $65.36.

$BNB also broke out, moving about 2.37 times wider than normal and fell 4.35% to $591.65.

All three posted ranges well over double their week-average.

$CRCLB slid to 55.92 USDT, down 9.63% in 24 h, after hitting a high of 62 USDT and a low of 55.25 USDT. The token's range was the widest at 12.07%, and it moved the most in absolute terms among the three.

Nvidia's bStock, $NVDAB, nudged lower to 159.13 USDT, a 1.47% dip, trading between 156.01 USDT and 162.82 USDT. It pulled the biggest USDT volume, about 25.6 million.

Micron's $MUB held near 753 USDT, down 1.78% with a 3.86% range, low of 739.39 USDT and high of 768.46 USDT. Volume was 3.6 million USDT.

$NVDAB barely slipped, down 0.93% to $159.49, while $TRX gave up 1.92% and sits at $0.307. On the other side $SHELL tanked hard, down 16.81% to $0.02618. Volume's still hefty, $NVDAB moved over 31.7 M USDT and $SHELL churned about 35.6 M USDT.

$PEPE barely budged, trading around $0.00000446. Its 24-hour swing was about a third tighter than the week's norm, sitting at 6.28% versus the usual 10.24%.

$SPCXB held steady near $139.9, down a hair-line 1.28%. The day's range was 4.32%, roughly 26% tighter than its average 5.84% swing.

$BTC slipped 3.64% in the last 24 h. The alt universe went even lower, with the median down 3.95% and 95% of the 19 coins losing ground, only 5% managed to stay up. That's a pretty broad drop across the board. $BTC held up about the same as the typical alt, falling just a hair less. The typical alt swung a 7.6% high-low range today.

$PEPE swung hard, its 24-hour range about 145% wider than usual, roughly two-and-a-half times its typical daily swing. The token dropped 15.37% and finished around $0.00000446.

$NVDAB also broke out of its norm, moving about 113% beyond its average range, so a little over double what you'd expect in a day. It slid 6.226% to end near $161.3.

Both memes and meme-stocks saw their volatility spike well past the week-long average. The data shows $PEPE's range hit 19.06% versus a 7.78% norm, while $NVDAB's hit 14.49% versus a 6.79% norm.

$ETH is up 0.504% against $BTC, so it's gaining a bit of ground. Meanwhile $BTC rose 1.456% in USD terms, but the median alt in the 24-hour basket nudged 1.973%, the typical alt outpaced Bitcoin. That median covers 19 of the most-traded alts. So overall, alts are leading the pack, while $ETH is tightening its spread versus $BTC.

$INIT surged 27.754% to $0.28429, trading a solid $41.66 M volume. Meanwhile $ONE jumped 22.899% and is now $0.001755 on $30.03 M of trades. On the flip side $ZEC slipped 12.539% to $1,005.02, still moving $266.58 M in quote volume.

$BTC slipped 2.0% to $73,502, bounced off a high of $75,442 and found support near $72,727. The pair moved about 3.7% in the 24-hour range and traded roughly $1.2 B in USDT volume.

$ETH took the biggest hit, down 4.18% to $2,045.84. It swung from $2,137.30 down to $2,006, a 6.4% range, the widest of the three, and logged about $677 M in quote volume.

$BNB fell 1.99% to $675.04, hovering between $692.64 and $670.06, a 3.3% swing, with $86.7 M USDT traded.

The standout stat: $BTC moved the most USDT volume, topping $1.19 B.

$BTC up 1.05% while the alt crowd ripped higher, 89% of the 19 coins rose, only 11% fell. The median alt jumped 2.8%, so the typical alt outperformed $BTC by a solid point. Those alts were swinging about a 6.77% 24-hour range on average.

Overall it was a broad rally led by the alt side, with $BTC holding its own but lagging the median mover.

$ONE went crazy, swinging about twice its usual daily range and ending at $0.001662. It dropped 20.5% in 24 h while the price band stretched nearly 39%, well over double the typical 17.6% swing.

$ETH wasn't far behind. The token moved roughly twice as far as it normally does, with an 8.8% range versus the usual 4.3% and a 4.9% dip to $2,123.51.

$XRP also felt the heat, trading in a band 55% wider than its week-average, 6.9% versus 4.5%, and slipping 3.8% to $1.1146.

$CRCLB is sitting at 67.63 USDT, up 0.044% on the day. It hit a high of 67.8 and a low of 66.92, so the 24h range is about 1.30% and it pulled in the biggest USDT volume at 2,485,824.

$MUB jumped to 696.82 USDT, up 0.35% with a 1.85% swing from 686.11 to 699.03. That's the widest move among the three and the largest absolute price change.

$SPYB slipped to 736.89 USDT, down 0.107% after trading between 726.89 and 737.72, a 1.47% range.

$ACT jumped 6.2% to $0.01148, trading in a tight $0.00998-$0.01298 band with over 8.4 M USDT volume. $ONE nudged up 3.6% to $0.00192, its range stayed between $0.00178 and $0.002476 while pulling in 43 M USDT. On the flip side, $PUMP fell 5.96% to $0.003675, sliding from a high of $0.003959 to a low of $0.003568 and still moving about 11.4 M USDT.
